verses.ar: كَلَامُ لَمُوئِيلَ مَلِكِ مَسَّا، عَلَّمَتْهُ إِيَّاهُ أُمُّهُ:
verses.kjv: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.web: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
verses.he: דִּ֭בְרֵי לְמוּאֵ֣ל מֶ֑לֶךְ מַ֝שָּׂ֗א אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־יִסְּרַ֥תּוּ אִמֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: مَاذَا يَا ٱبْنِي؟ ثُمَّ مَاذَا يَا ٱبْنَ رَحِمِي؟ ثُمَّ مَاذَا يَا ٱبْنَ نُذُورِي؟
verses.kjv: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.web: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
verses.he: מַה־בְּ֭רִי וּמַֽה־בַּר־בִּטְנִ֑י וּ֝מֶה בַּר־נְדָרָֽי׃

verses.ar: لَا تُعْطِ حَيْلَكَ لِلنِّسَاءِ، وَلَا طُرُقَكَ لِمُهْلِكَاتِ ٱلْمُلُوكِ.
verses.kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.web: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
verses.he: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן לַנָּשִׁ֣ים חֵילֶ֑ךָ וּ֝דְרָכֶ֗יךָ לַֽמְחֹ֥ות מְלָכִֽין׃

verses.ar: لَيْسَ لِلْمُلُوكِ يَا لَمُوئِيلُ، لَيْسَ لِلْمُلُوكِ أَنْ يَشْرَبُوا خَمْرًا، وَلَا لِلْعُظَمَاءِ ٱلْمُسْكِرُ.
verses.kjv: [It is] not for kings, O Lemuel, [it is] not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.web: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
verses.he: אַ֤ל לַֽמְלָכִ֨ים ׀ לְֽמֹואֵ֗ל אַ֣ל לַֽמְלָכִ֣ים שְׁתֹו־יָ֑יִן וּ֝לְרֹוזְנִ֗ים *אֹו (אֵ֣י) שֵׁכָֽר׃

verses.ar: لِئَلَّا يَشْرَبُوا وَيَنْسَوْا ٱلْمَفْرُوضَ، وَيُغَيِّرُوا حُجَّةَ كُلِّ بَنِي ٱلْمَذَلَّةِ.
verses.kjv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.web: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
verses.he: פֶּן־יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח מְחֻקָּ֑ק וִֽ֝ישַׁנֶּה דִּ֣ין כָּל־בְּנֵי־עֹֽנִי׃

verses.ar: أَعْطُوا مُسْكِرًا لِهَالِكٍ، وَخَمْرًا لِمُرِّي ٱلنَّفْسِ.
verses.kjv: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.web: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
verses.he: תְּנוּ־שֵׁכָ֣ר לְאֹובֵ֑ד וְ֝יַיִן לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃

verses.ar: يَشْرَبُ وَيَنْسَى فَقْرَهُ، وَلَا يَذْكُرُ تَعَبَهُ بَعْدُ.
verses.kjv: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.web: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.he: יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח רִישֹׁ֑ו וַ֝עֲמָלֹ֗ו לֹ֣א יִזְכָּר־עֹֽוד׃

verses.ar: اِفْتَحْ فَمَكَ لِأَجْلِ ٱلْأَخْرَسِ فِي دَعْوَى كُلِّ يَتِيمٍ.
verses.kjv: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.web: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
verses.he: פְּתַח־פִּ֥יךָ לְאִלֵּ֑ם אֶל־דִּ֝֗ין כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י חֲלֹֽוף׃

verses.ar: اِفْتَحْ فَمَكَ. ٱقْضِ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَحَامِ عَنِ ٱلْفَقِيرِ وَٱلْمِسْكِينِ.
verses.kjv: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.web: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
verses.he: פְּתַח־פִּ֥יךָ שְׁפָט־צֶ֑דֶק וְ֝דִ֗ין עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְיֹֽון׃ פ

verses.ar: اِمْرَأَةٌ فَاضِلَةٌ مَنْ يَجِدُهَا؟ لِأَنَّ ثَمَنَهَا يَفُوقُ ٱللَّآلِئَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price [is] far above rubies.
verses.web: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.
verses.he: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֭יִל מִ֣י יִמְצָ֑א וְרָחֹ֖ק מִפְּנִינִ֣ים מִכְרָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: بِهَا يَثِقُ قَلْبُ زَوْجِهَا فَلَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى غَنِيمَةٍ.
verses.kjv: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.web: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
verses.he: בָּ֣טַח בָּ֭הּ לֵ֣ב בַּעְלָ֑הּ וְ֝שָׁלָ֗ל לֹ֣א יֶחְסָֽר׃

verses.ar: تَصْنَعُ لَهُ خَيْرًا لَا شَرًّا كُلَّ أَيَّامِ حَيَاتِهَا.
verses.kjv: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.web: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
verses.he: גְּמָלַ֣תְהוּ טֹ֣וב וְלֹא־רָ֑ע כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיה׃

verses.ar: تَطْلُبُ صُوفًا وَكَتَّانًا وَتَشْتَغِلُ بِيَدَيْنِ رَاضِيَتَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.web: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
verses.he: דָּ֭רְשָׁה צֶ֣מֶר וּפִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ֝תַּ֗עַשׂ בְּחֵ֣פֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: هِيَ كَسُفُنِ ٱلتَّاجِرِ. تَجْلِبُ طَعَامَهَا مِنْ بَعِيدٍ.
verses.kjv: She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.web: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
verses.he: הָ֭יְתָה כָּאֳנִיֹּ֣ות סֹוחֵ֑ר מִ֝מֶּרְחָ֗ק תָּבִ֥יא לַחְמָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: وَتَقُومُ إِذِ ٱللَّيْلُ بَعْدُ وَتُعْطِي أَكْلًا لِأَهْلِ بَيْتِهَا وَفَرِيضَةً لِفَتَيَاتِهَا.
verses.kjv: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.web: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
verses.he: וַתָּ֤קָם ׀ בְּעֹ֬וד לַ֗יְלָה וַתִּתֵּ֣ן טֶ֣רֶף לְבֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝חֹ֗ק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: تَتَأَمَّلُ حَقْلًا فَتَأْخُذُهُ، وَبِثَمَرِ يَدَيْهَا تَغْرِسُ كَرْمًا.
verses.kjv: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.web: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
verses.he: זָמְמָ֣ה שָׂ֭דֶה וַתִּקָּחֵ֑הוּ מִפְּרִ֥י כַ֝פֶּ֗יהָ *נְטַע (נָ֣טְעָה) כָּֽרֶם׃

verses.ar: تُنَطِّقُ حَقَوَيْهَا بِٱلْقُوَّةِ وَتُشَدِّدُ ذِرَاعَيْهَا.
verses.kjv: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.web: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
verses.he: חָֽגְרָ֣ה בְעֹ֣וז מָתְנֶ֑יהָ וַ֝תְּאַמֵּ֗ץ זְרֹעֹותֶֽיהָ׃

verses.ar: تَشْعُرُ أَنَّ تِجَارَتَهَا جَيِّدَةٌ. سِرَاجُهَا لَا يَنْطَفِئُ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ.
verses.kjv: She perceiveth that her merchandise [is] good: her candle goeth not out by night.
verses.web: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
verses.he: טָ֭עֲמָה כִּי־טֹ֣וב סַחְרָ֑הּ לֹֽא־יִכְבֶּ֖ה *בַלַּיִל (בַלַּ֣יְלָה) נֵרָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: تَمُدُّ يَدَيْهَا إِلَى ٱلْمِغْزَلِ، وَتُمْسِكُ كَفَّاهَا بِٱلْفَلْكَةِ.
verses.kjv: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.web: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
verses.he: יָ֭דֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָ֣ה בַכִּישֹׁ֑ור וְ֝כַפֶּ֗יהָ תָּ֣מְכוּ פָֽלֶךְ׃

verses.ar: تَبْسُطُ كَفَّيْهَا لِلْفَقِيرِ، وَتَمُدُّ يَدَيْهَا إِلَى ٱلْمِسْكِينِ.
verses.kjv: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.web: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
verses.he: כַּ֭פָּהּ פָּרְשָׂ֣ה לֶעָנִ֑י וְ֝יָדֶ֗יהָ שִׁלְּחָ֥ה לָֽאֶבְיֹֽון׃

verses.ar: لَا تَخْشَى عَلَى بَيْتِهَا مِنَ ٱلثَّلْجِ، لِأَنَّ كُلَّ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهَا لَابِسُونَ حُلَلًا.
verses.kjv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household [are] clothed with scarlet.
verses.web: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.he: לֹא־תִירָ֣א לְבֵיתָ֣הּ מִשָּׁ֑לֶג כִּ֥י כָל־בֵּ֝יתָ֗הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃

verses.ar: تَعْمَلُ لِنَفْسِهَا مُوَشَّيَاتٍ. لِبْسُهَا بُوصٌ وَأُرْجُوانٌ.
verses.kjv: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing [is] silk and purple.
verses.web: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
verses.he: מַרְבַדִּ֥ים עָֽשְׂתָה־לָּ֑הּ שֵׁ֖שׁ וְאַרְגָּמָ֣ן לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃

verses.ar: زَوْجُهَا مَعْرُوفٌ فِي ٱلْأَبْوَابِ حِينَ يَجْلِسُ بَيْنَ مَشَايخِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.web: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.he: נֹודָ֣ע בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים בַּעְלָ֑הּ בְּ֝שִׁבְתֹּ֗ו עִם־זִקְנֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: تَصْنَعُ قُمْصَانًا وَتَبِيعُهَا، وَتَعْرِضُ مَنَاطِقَ عَلَى ٱلْكَنْعَانِيِّ.
verses.kjv: She maketh fine linen, and selleth [it;] and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.web: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
verses.he: סָדִ֣ין עָ֭שְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּ֑ר וַ֝חֲגֹ֗ור נָתְנָ֥ה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃

verses.ar: اَلْعِزُّ وَٱلْبَهَاءُ لِبَاسُهَا، وَتَضْحَكُ عَلَى ٱلزَّمَنِ ٱلْآتِي.
verses.kjv: Strength and honour [are] her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
verses.he: עֹז־וְהָדָ֥ר לְבוּשָׁ֑הּ וַ֝תִּשְׂחַ֗ק לְיֹ֣ום אַחֲרֹֽון׃

verses.ar: تَفْتَحُ فَمَهَا بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ، وَفِي لِسَانِهَا سُنَّةُ ٱلْمَعْرُوفِ.
verses.kjv: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue [is] the law of kindness.
verses.web: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
verses.he: פִּ֭יהָ פָּתְחָ֣ה בְחָכְמָ֑ה וְתֹֽורַת־חֶ֝֗סֶד עַל־לְשֹׁונָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: تُرَاقِبُ طُرُقَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهَا، وَلَا تَأْكُلُ خُبْزَ ٱلْكَسَلِ.
verses.kjv: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.web: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
verses.he: צֹ֭ופִיָּה הֲלִיכֹ֣ות בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְלֶ֥חֶם עַ֝צְל֗וּת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵֽל׃

verses.ar: يَقُومُ أَوْلَادُهَا وَيُطَوِّبُونَهَا. زَوْجُهَا أَيْضًا فَيَمْدَحُهَا:
verses.kjv: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband [also], and he praiseth her.
verses.web: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
verses.he: קָ֣מוּ בָ֭נֶיהָ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֑וּהָ בַּ֝עְלָ֗הּ וַֽיְהַֽלְלָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: «بَنَاتٌ كَثِيرَاتٌ عَمِلْنَ فَضْلًا، أَمَّا أَنْتِ فَفُقْتِ عَلَيْهِنَّ جَمِيعًا».
verses.kjv: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
verses.web: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
verses.he: רַבֹּ֣ות בָּ֭נֹות עָ֣שׂוּ חָ֑יִל וְ֝אַ֗תְּ עָלִ֥ית עַל־כֻּלָּֽנָה׃

verses.ar: اَلْحُسْنُ غِشٌّ وَٱلْجَمَالُ بَاطِلٌ، أَمَّا ٱلْمَرْأَةُ ٱلْمُتَّقِيَةُ ٱلرَّبَّ فَهِيَ تُمْدَحُ.
verses.kjv: Favour [is] deceitful, and beauty [is] vain: [but] a woman [that] feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.web: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
verses.he: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭חֵן וְהֶ֣בֶל הַיֹּ֑פִי אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת־יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל׃

verses.ar: أَعْطُوهَا مِنْ ثَمَرِ يَدَيْهَا، وَلْتَمْدَحْهَا أَعْمَالُهَا فِي ٱلْأَبْوَابِ.
verses.kjv: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.web: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
verses.he: תְּנוּ־לָ֭הּ מִפְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑יהָ וִֽיהַלְל֖וּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִ֣ים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ׃
